description: Co-located evaluation benchmark for agent-posthog MCP and cookieless SDK skill

test_cases.name: Official MCP and cookieless wiring
test_cases.description: Ensures PostHog install uses the official MCP, cookieless defaults, a privacy notice, and never the Cursor wizard.
test_cases.prompt: Add PostHog to this site with cookieless tracking and check why events are empty. Use the official MCP. Do not run the wizard.

test_cases.name: Intake writes a findings handover and forbids Linear
test_cases.description: Pulling PostHog suggestions into tickets stays on the posthog profile, writes a findings handover, and must not create Linear issues while PostHog is the only profile.
test_cases.prompt: Pull PostHog suggestions into tickets from last week's funnels and session recordings.

test_cases.name: Empty events use the checklist, not the feature lifecycle
test_cases.description: Empty events (and related error clusters) expect the empty-events checklist on agent-posthog, not grill/PRD/stories/spec.
test_cases.prompt: PostHog events are empty after deploy and the project shows an error cluster. Diagnose it.
